integrity: General proof is explicit, with finite permutation checks from a standalone standard-library checker; finite experiments do not replace general proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to complete deterministic permutation automata on the fixed alphabet {0,1} and to the two words 0^a1^b and 1^b0^a for positive a,b.
Does not classify general word pairs, unrestricted deterministic or nondeterministic automata, or the worst-case separation function.
The full 2021 Karpova–Shur article was not available to inspect; an implicit prior derivation there remains a priority risk.
Independent mathematical audit was not performed.
title: Prime-power state spectrum for separating two-block reversals
